structure: MS CCRS Social Studies, one PDF containing two editions back to back: the 2022 edition (u1-u1641, pages 1-173) and an earlier 2021 edition (u1642 onward, pages 174+). Each edition: front matter (cover, TOC, acknowledgments, committees, introduction, strands overview of Civics/Civil Rights/Economics/Geography/History, K-8 sequencing, middle-school course-option table), then Primary Courses K-8 each with a title page (e.g. 'Grade 1 Citizenship at School' plus a note that examples are not exhaustive), then a two-column table 'Standard | Objectives'. Codes: K-3 strand-based (K.CI.1 Civics, .E. Economics, .CR. Civil Rights, .G. Geography, .H. History; e.g. 2.G.4); grade 4 theme code 4.MS.n; grades 5-8 plain numbers (5.1, 6.16, 7.9, 8.10); compacted grade 7 uses 7C.n; Carnegie-unit courses use course prefixes (MS, WH, USH, USG, E, ITG, AWG, AAS, HAME, PAD, PSY.I, PSY.II, SOC, LRE, MIN, WC). Standard text sits in column C1 and its numbered Objectives (with inline e.g. lists) in the adjacent cell; no separate example/teacher-note blocks, so objectives are labeled standards. Grade 4-8 pages carry a note 'This course contains all Social Studies Strands'. High school Carnegie-unit courses (required: Mississippi Studies, World History, US History, US Government, Economics; electives: Intro to Geography, Advanced World Geography, African American Studies, History of the Ancient Middle East, Problems of American Democracy, Psychology I/II, Sociology, Law Related Education, Minority Studies, Western Civilization) are labeled grades 9-12 with the course title. Grade labels come from the grade/course title pages and page headings.

issues: u1642-u2592: the file contains a second, earlier (2021) edition of the same standards appended after the 2022 edition (page 174 onward). Labeled with the same grades/courses as the 2022 edition; the assembler will see duplicate-but-differing grade/course content. 2021 grade 6 theme is 'Civics and the World' (strand codes 6.CI/6.E/6.CR/6.G/6.H) versus 2022 'World Geography' (6.1-6.16).

u1936-u2583 (2021 edition objectives): objective numbering in extracted cells is offset/inconsistent (e.g. '5. Define citizen...', '8. Illustrate...', numbering continuing from hidden items); text left as extracted.
u1416: source objective numbering jumps from 2 to 4 (no 3); u2381 (8.4 objectives) lists case names as numbered items 11-14; text left as extracted.

u339-u340, u391-u392, etc.: grade title pages ('Grade N <theme>') labeled standards; the one-line note '*The examples listed within the document are not an exhaustive list' labeled backup. '2021 page references' like u1929 'Page 14 - 18' labeled backup.
u564, u604, u643, u2148, u2185, u2192-u2195, u2202-u2205, u2210-u2213, u2218-u2219: boilerplate 'This course contains all Social Studies Strands' note (and stray '.') labeled backup.
u742-u793 and u2315-u2360: compacted Grade 7 (7C) labeled grades '7', course null (it is a grade-level compacted course covering grade 7 content); could alternatively be treated as a course.
Carnegie-unit courses (Mississippi Studies, Introduction to Geography) are also offered as grade 7-9 electives per the course-sequence table (u289-u337, u1877-u1926); labeled 9-12 per guide.

Reviewer: the PDF contains the 2022 standards (u1-u1641), a superseded 2021 edition (u1642-u3211) and the 2018 standards with 2021 redlines (u3212-end). The 2022 edition covers every grade/course except Humanities, so only the 2021 Humanities course is kept from the older editions; all other older-edition text was moved to backup.
